data.dataset: UCI-447 Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems (Helwig et al. 2015)

bounded_conditions: 3 feature(s) constant in train are excluded from dead-dim test

representation_config.diagnostic_normalization: train z-score, then row l2 (A1 convention)

A1.supported_claim: frozen 170-d per-cycle statistics retain multi-dimensional structure on train cycles

A3-cooler-CE.falsifier: sign disagreement in >10% of strata (other components held fixed)
A3-cooler-CE.mechanism: reduced cooler efficiency lowers measured cooling efficiency
A3-cooler-CE.scope: UCI-447 test rig, stable cycles, fixed 60 s load profile

A3-pump-FS1.falsifier: sign disagreement in >10% of strata (other components held fixed)
A3-pump-FS1.mechanism: internal leakage returns flow to tank, reducing delivered volume flow
A3-pump-FS1.scope: UCI-447 test rig, stable cycles, fixed 60 s load profile

A3-valve-FS1early.falsifier: sign disagreement in >10% of strata (other components held fixed)
A3-valve-FS1early.mechanism: switching lag delays flow onset in the first 10 s of the cycle
A3-valve-FS1early.scope: UCI-447 test rig, stable cycles, fixed 60 s load profile

unwarranted_claims: remaining useful life or time-to-failure of any component
fault diagnosis for components other than cooler, valve, pump, accumulator
condition grades not present in training (e.g. interpolated severities)
any claim about plants or rigs other than the UCI-447 test rig
root-cause attribution among simultaneously degraded components
claims on cycles whose evidence failed integrity without repair
